title: elsholtzia cyprianii var. longipilosa
intro: Elsholtzia cyprianii var. longipilosa, commonly known as Vietnamese mint, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include the treatment of digestive issues, fever reduction, and the alleviation of respiratory problems, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Vietnamese mint include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which help in the management of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Vietnamese mint include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
